notes.title: Building our Futature 1.00.7 bugfix update
notes.notes:
We have updated the game to fix and improve some bugs and issues that have been reported. Special thanks to NoctemRose for reporting many of these.

Changes:

Fixed 23 typos and grammatical issues
Fixed 10 continuity errors
Fixed 48 cases of text not fitting in textbox
Fixed 2 graphical issues
Fixed 12 other issues
